prompt_md: You fold a sheet of paper in half three times, then punch one hole through all the layers, away from any fold. How many holes do you see when you unfold it?
prompt_short: Fold paper in half 3 times, punch one hole. Holes when unfolded?
hint_md: How many layers does each fold make?
explain_intuition_md: Each fold doubles the layers: 2, then 4, then 8. One punch goes through all 8 layers. Three folds multiply, they don't add.
